description: Documentation explaining how to check if a model supports function calling, how to perform parallel function calling, and examples of their usage with various models and providers. It includes code snippets demonstrating the process of sending prompts, handling function calls, executing external functions, and re-sending information to the model for coherent responses.

methods.name: litellm.supports_function_calling
methods.description: Checks if a given model supports function calling.

methods.name: litellm.supports_parallel_function_calling
methods.description: Checks if a given model supports parallel function calling.

methods.name: litellm.completion
methods.description: Performs a completion request with options for function calling, including parallel and sequential methods.

methods.name: litellm.utils.function_to_dict
methods.description: Converts a Python function with a docstring to a JSON schema dictionary suitable for OpenAI's function calling.
